question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Trailing-four-quarter operating cash flow covers only {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value} of net income, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2022, and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}, far above the annual trend-table reading of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value}, which was itself the highest of five years. The gap is not operating. The quarter's net income of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0} sits against operating cash flow of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.0} because the income statement carries a non-cash, non-operating mark-to-market gain on the retained Sandisk stake and a non-cash charge on the debt-for-equity exchange, both described in MD&A and the debt note. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}, above one, so income moves more than cash: the opposite of a smoothed earnings series. Working capital absorbs little. Receivables grew {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change.value} year over year, a {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income.value|pct} share of net income, and the cash-flow statement's line matches the balance-sheet change exactly (articulation gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap.value}). Inventory grew {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} with an articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap.value}. Payables supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change.value} on the cash-flow statement, but the year-earlier payables balance is missing from the record, so that articulation cannot be tested. Operating cash flow for the quarter, {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}, is up {growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.value|pct} on a year earlier and {growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} on the prior quarter, consistent with revenue growth of {growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct} and a gross margin at its series high. Net income is a poor guide to cash earnings this year, but the reason is disclosed and the operating cash engine is real. An earnings adjustment for the Sandisk gain is warranted, but no calculator field carries the gain, so none is listed.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Reported net income overstates cash earnings because of a disclosed non-cash mark-to-market gain; operating cash flow itself is strong, articulates cleanly with the balance sheet and is not absorbed by working capital.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are not outrunning revenue. Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, third lowest of eight quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} a year earlier; the trailing figure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value}. Revenue grew {growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct} year over year and {growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} on the prior quarter, which MD&A attributes to exabyte volume and price per exabyte, and the gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} is the highest of six quarters, consistent with the pricing claim. Contract liabilities are not tagged at this date, so the deferred-revenue test cannot be run. The notes reader found no revenue policy wording change, no new variable-consideration, principal-versus-agent or standalone-selling-price judgment, no extended-terms or bill-and-hold disclosure, and this is not a fiscal fourth quarter. The one open item is the largest customer: its share of net receivables is {concentration.facts.35.value|pct}, up from {concentration.facts.13.value|pct} at fiscal year end and {concentration.facts.24.value|pct} at the prior quarter end, while its share of quarterly revenue is {concentration.facts.29.value|pct}. A receivable share well above the revenue share means that customer's billings fell late in the quarter or carry longer terms, and the prose gives no reason.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Clean on timing, policy and terms; one unresolved concentration signal in the largest customer's receivable share.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Warranty is the only reserve the record tags. The accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual.value} a year earlier; the ratio to quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value}, fourth highest of eight quarters, slightly below the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value} and above the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value}; and the numbers reader shows releases of prior estimates shrinking to nil for nine months. The reserve is not thinning and is not being released into income. The bad-debt allowance and inventory reserve are untagged in every period, so those ratios cannot be tested; the note calls credit-loss reserves not material. Goodwill shows no impairment indicator and an unchanged carrying amount. The effective tax rate is the estimate that moves income: the trailing rate is {tax_rate.value|pct} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.value}, and the note names the tax-free Sandisk gain, excess windfall tax benefits recognized in income tax expense, the FDDEI deduction and credits as drivers. The windfall benefit is discrete and share-price dependent, the tax-free gain ends once the remaining shares are exchanged, and the comparative quarter carried a one-time deferred tax benefit from a Separation-related asset transfer, so year-over-year tax comparisons are distorted in both directions. Unrecognized tax benefits rose, which builds rather than releases reserve. The new derivative for the tendered convertible notes' conversion feature is a fair-value estimate with an immaterial gain. No estimate change raised income; the windfall benefit lowers tax but its amount is not in the calculator, so no adjustment is listed.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Reserves are stable or building; the low effective tax rate is driven by a tax-free non-operating gain and discrete windfall benefits that will not persist.

cost_deferral.finding: Research and development capitalization cannot be tested: the company tags R&D under a concept the trend table does not read and tags no capitalized software, a concept mismatch rather than missing spending. MD&A attributes the R&D increase to product development and performance-linked compensation, both expensed. Soft assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} of total assets, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} a quarter earlier but up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} a year earlier; the swing follows the Sandisk equity stake and tax receivables, not capitalized costs. Trailing capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value} is below the year-earlier {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure.value} and close to depreciation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.value}, and construction in progress fell, so costs are not accumulating on the balance sheet. Items presented as non-recurring do recur: business-realignment charges continue, a further termination cost is expected in the rest of 2026 and the reserve rose; the new caption for costs in connection with the debt-for-equity exchange reflects a discount on Sandisk shares, and the prose says the remaining shares will be exchanged for common stock by the end of 2026 without saying whether a discount will recur. The non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be measured because the earnings release body is absent from the bundle.
cost_deferral.verdict: No cost deferral found; the watch items are recurring realignment charges and a possibly repeating exchange discount, with the R&D and non-GAAP tests untestable.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No factoring or supplier-finance lift is visible: proceeds from sale of receivables have no row this year to date, although the concept exists in the record for earlier periods, and supplier-finance obligations and guarantee exposure are untagged in every period. The quarter's financing is the structural item. The cash-flow statement shows borrowing issued of {cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.parts.this_year_to_date.value} and repayments of {cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.this_year_to_date.value} year to date, while total debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.value} to {terms.debt_now.value}; the bridge loan and term loan were retired in a non-cash exchange of Sandisk shares, so the disposal of those shares never passes through investing cash flow and the discount given to the counterparties is a non-cash income-statement charge. That is disclosed and does not touch operating cash flow, but free cash flow to equity of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.value} with net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing} understates how much the balance sheet deleveraged. Inside operating cash flow MD&A names three timing items: realization of income taxes receivable, variable compensation accrued but not yet paid, and a reduction in hedging accruals since the Separation. None has a calculator field, so their size against the quarter's {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value} cannot be stated and no adjustment is listed. All remaining debt, the 2028 convertible notes, is classified current because the conversion condition has been met; tendered notes will be settled in cash for the amount above principal in June 2026, the fair value of the notes is far above carrying value, and the diluted share count of {terms.diluted_shares.value} against {terms.shares_outstanding.value} shares outstanding shows the conversion feature is a real claim on equity. Purchase obligations fell to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value}; the operating lease liability is {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability.value}; no variable-interest entity is disclosed. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} over four quarters is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}, and the quarter's charge rose against a year earlier.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No operating cash-flow engineering found; the non-cash debt-for-shares exchange and the in-the-money convertible are disclosed structural items, and three MD&A timing items inside operating cash flow remain unquantified.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Disclosure controls are reported effective with no change in internal control; there is no auditor's report in a 10-Q bundle, and the 8-K index shows no auditor-change or non-reliance item. No chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller departure appears; the only personnel items are selling plans adopted by the chief executive, a director and the chief legal officer. The numbers reader compared superseded prior-quarter rows and found no restated value; the convertible conversion price moved slightly without a restatement marker, which the notes reader shows as a routine adjustment to the stated term. Tag discipline is the weak spot: depreciation is tagged under a different concept from the prior 10-Q, dividends paid under a different concept from the prior year, receivables are printed at two precisions under one paragraph, and a liquidation preference is still tagged for preferred stock whose carrying amount is zero after the mandatory conversion. The debt note and MD&A give different figures for the exchange cost; the tagged components in the numbers report show the MD&A figure is the total loss on extinguishment and the note's figure is the term-loan component alone, with the senior-note issuance-cost write-off the remainder. The 8-K file contradicts itself on whether a results 8-K exists and carries no body, so the earnings release cannot be matched to the 10-Q. A late-filing notice exists for the period ended in late 2023, two years before this filing. Related-party exposure is the transition services agreement with Sandisk, called not material; no subsidiary-list diff or comment letter is in the input.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No control or audit red flag; several XBRL tagging inconsistencies and an unverifiable earnings release are the only signals.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Of the notes items carrying an expected direction, the numbers confirm the debt retirement, the exchange charge, the preferred conversion, the revenue, margin and receivables explanations, the restructuring continuation and the tax-rate drivers. They contradict the inventory item: MD&A describes a reduction in inventory, but the balance rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} year over year and the year-to-date cash-flow line is an increase of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date.value}, so the prose refers to a smaller cash build than the prior year's {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}, not to a lower balance. They leave unresolved the forward-looking items (lower interest, end of participating-securities allocation, buybacks, the remaining Sandisk exchange, derivative remeasurement, hedge reclassification), the end-market and geographic revenue claims for which the record carries no rows, and the operating cash-flow timing items that have no calculator field. The note-versus-MD&A exchange-cost difference is explained by tagged components. The 8-K earnings release is not in the bundle, so it cannot be matched to the 10-Q.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Prose and numbers agree on every material item, with one literal contradiction on inventory that is a wording matter, and the earnings release unverifiable.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: days sales of inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, the lowest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} a year earlier, and the annual figure of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} is the lowest of five years; the inventory reserve and write-downs are untagged, so the reserve cannot be observed, but turnover gives no obsolescence signal. Purchase commitments in excess of need: nothing found; purchase obligations fell to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} while revenue grew {growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct}. Customer concentration: the top ten customers are {concentration.facts.27.value|pct} of quarterly revenue, below the prior quarter's {concentration.facts.16.value|pct} and the year-ago {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}; the largest customer is {concentration.facts.29.value|pct} of revenue but {concentration.facts.35.value|pct} of receivables, up from {concentration.facts.13.value|pct} and {concentration.facts.24.value|pct} at the two prior balance dates, so receivable concentration is rising faster than revenue concentration. Channel stuffing: nothing found; receivables grew with revenue at a stable days-sales-outstanding of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, revenue grew {growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} quarter on quarter with the gross margin at its high, and the cloud end market the prose describes is direct hyperscale demand rather than a distribution channel. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found; the only related party is Sandisk, a former subsidiary whose shares the company holds as an investment and is exchanging for debt and stock, not a customer the company finances, and the transition services agreement is called not material.
industry_lens.verdict: Inventory, commitments, channel and circular-deal tests are clean; receivable concentration in the largest customer is the one industry signal to watch.

Total debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.value} to {terms.debt_now.value}, far beyond the net cash repayment, and the equity-securities stake is lower at quarter end despite the quarter's gain, which is what a non-cash share-for-debt exchange leaves behind.
The loss on extinguishment is tagged with a term-loan component equal to the note's figure, dated to the exchange month.

The tagged unrealized gain exceeds operating income, which is why operating cash flow covers only {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value} of net income and accruals over assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}.

anomalies.name: Realignment charges continue
anomalies.what: Nine-month business-realignment charges are described as one-time termination benefits, yet the reserve is higher than at fiscal year end and the note expects further termination costs in the rest of 2026.

anomalies.name: R&D capitalization untestable
anomalies.what: R&D is tagged under a concept the trend table does not read and no capitalized-software concept is tagged, so the capitalized-over-expensed ratio is unfilled for every period.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP gap unavailable
anomalies.what: No non-GAAP net income exists in the record and the earnings-release body is not in the bundle, so the non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be measured in a quarter with a large exchange charge and a large unrealized gain.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share moves with the Sandisk stake
anomalies.name_ko: 무형성 자산 비중이 샌디스크 지분에 따라 변동
anomalies.what: Soft assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} of assets, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} but up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct}; the numbers reader ties the swings to the equity-securities stake and tax receivables rather than to capitalized costs.

anomalies.name: Bridge loan borrowed in cash, retired without cash
anomalies.name_ko: 브리지론은 현금 차입, 상환은 비현금 주식교환
anomalies.what: Borrowing issued year to date is {cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.parts.this_year_to_date.value} and repayments {cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.this_year_to_date.value}, yet debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.value} to {terms.debt_now.value}; the balance was retired by exchanging Sandisk shares, so the share disposal and the discount on it bypass investing cash flow.

anomalies.name: Income-tax receivable timing lifts operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 법인세 환급 시점 효과가 영업현금흐름을 끌어올림
anomalies.what: MD&A credits a large improvement in other assets and liabilities to realization of income taxes receivable, partly offset by higher tax payments; the numbers reader tags the accrued-tax paydown but no row sizes the receivable realization, so the one-off lift inside the quarter's {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value} is unquantified.

anomalies.name: Variable compensation accrued but not yet paid
anomalies.what: MD&A ties an improvement in accrued compensation to the timing of variable compensation payments while R&D and SG&A rose on performance-linked pay; the payment will fall into a later period's operating cash flow and no row sizes it.

anomalies.name: Hedging accrual release
anomalies.what: MD&A attributes an improvement in accrued expenses to much lower derivative hedging since the Separation; the amount has no row and the prose does not say how much exposure is now unhedged.

anomalies.name: Convertible notes' fair value far above carrying, with cash settlement elected
anomalies.name_ko: 전환사채 공정가치가 장부가를 크게 상회, 초과분 현금결제 선택
anomalies.what: Debt now is {terms.debt_now.value}, all current, while the numbers reader prints a fair value many times the carrying amount; the company elected to cash-settle the conversion value above principal on tendered notes, and diluted shares of {terms.diluted_shares.value} against {terms.shares_outstanding.value} outstanding show the claim on equity.

anomalies.name: Receivables-sale concept exists in history, not this period
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 매각 태그가 과거에는 있으나 당기에는 없음
anomalies.what: Proceeds from sale of receivables are in the record for earlier periods but have no row this year to date; supplier-finance obligations and guarantees are untagged, so no factoring or supply-chain-finance lift can be measured.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} and the quarter's charge rose against a year earlier; it is a real cost already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}.

anomalies.name: Purchase obligations falling
anomalies.what: Unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} a year earlier while revenue grew; the notes carry only a standing description, so the decline is unexplained but benign.

anomalies.name: All remaining debt classified current
anomalies.what: Noncurrent debt is zero and current debt is {terms.debt_now.value}, the 2028 convertible notes; the note says the conversion condition was met and the classification has held each quarter since mid-2025.

anomalies.name: Depreciation tag changed between consecutive 10-Qs
anomalies.what: The trigger 10-Q tags depreciation under a different concept from the prior 10-Q, and dividends paid under a different concept from the prior year; the calculator chained them with a tags-differ flag, but a reader chaining by tag finds no common row.

anomalies.name: Stale liquidation preference tagged after conversion
anomalies.name_ko: 전환 완료 후에도 남은 우선주 청산가치 태그
anomalies.what: A temporary-equity liquidation preference is still tagged at the fiscal-year-end figure while the carrying amount is zero and the note says all preferred shares were converted; the stale fact contradicts the prose and is a tagging artefact.

anomalies.name: Note and MD&A give different exchange-cost figures
anomalies.name_ko: 주석과 경영진 설명의 교환비용 수치 불일치
anomalies.what: The debt note and MD&A state different amounts for the exchange cost; the tagged total loss on extinguishment matches MD&A and the term-loan component matches the note, with the issuance-cost write-off the difference, so the documents reconcile but read inconsistently.

anomalies.name: Earnings release absent from the bundle
anomalies.what: The 8-K file says no results 8-K is on record yet lists one filed the day before the 10-Q; no body is present, so release figures, guidance and non-GAAP measures cannot be matched to the 10-Q.

anomalies.name: Prior late-filing notice
anomalies.what: The 8-K index lists a late-filing notice for the period ended in late 2023; it is two years old and no later notice or amendment appears.

anomalies.name: Insider selling plans adopted
anomalies.what: The chief executive, a director and the chief legal officer adopted selling plans in February and March 2026, in the quarter the convertible notes went deep in the money and the Sandisk gain was booked; no numeric counterpart exists.

anomalies.name: Receivables printed at two precisions
anomalies.what: Net receivables appear twice under one paragraph at different rounding, beside the concentration facts; the difference is precision only and neither row is marked restated.

anomalies.name: Conversion price changed without a restatement marker
anomalies.what: The convertible conversion price and capped-call terms moved slightly from the prior 10-Q without a restatement marker; the notes reader shows the new figures stated as current terms, a routine dividend-driven adjustment rather than a quiet restatement.

anomalies.name: Receivable concentration rising in the largest customer
anomalies.what: Customer one's share of receivables went from {concentration.facts.13.value|pct} at fiscal year end to {concentration.facts.24.value|pct} at the prior quarter end to {concentration.facts.35.value|pct} now, while its revenue share is {concentration.facts.29.value|pct} and the top ten's revenue share eased to {concentration.facts.27.value|pct}; the prose states the figures without explanation.

anomalies.name: Top-ten revenue share eases from prior quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 상위 열 개 고객 매출 비중 전분기 대비 소폭 하락
anomalies.what: Top ten customers are {concentration.facts.27.value|pct} of quarterly revenue against {concentration.facts.16.value|pct} the prior quarter and {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} a year earlier; the prose's percentages match the tagged facts.

anomalies.name: Inventory days at series low
anomalies.what: Days sales of inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, lowest of six quarters, and the annual {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} is lowest of five years against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} a year earlier; consistent with the shipments explanation, though the reserve itself is untagged.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value}배에 그치고 발생액 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}로 회사 역사상 가장 높지만, 그 차이는 샌디스크 보유지분의 비현금 시가평가이익 때문이며 영업현금흐름 자체는 분기에 {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}로 전년 대비 {growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.value|pct} 늘었다. 매출채권 증가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change.value}는 현금흐름표와 정확히 일치한다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}일로 여덟 분기 중 세 번째로 낮아 매출채권이 매출보다 앞서 늘지 않았고, 정책 변경이나 특별 결제조건도 없다. 다만 최대 고객의 매출채권 비중이 {concentration.facts.35.value|pct}로 매출 비중 {concentration.facts.29.value|pct}보다 훨씬 높아진 점은 설명이 없다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 보증충당금은 {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value}로 늘고 과거 추정치 환입이 줄어 충당금이 얇아지지 않았다. 유효세율은 {tax_rate.value|pct}로 낮은데 이는 비과세 샌디스크 이익과 일회성 주식보상 세금혜택 때문이며 지속되기 어렵다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 연구개발비 자본화는 태그 불일치로 검증할 수 없고, 무형성 자산 비중 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct}의 변동은 샌디스크 지분에 따른 것이다. 설비투자 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}는 감가상각 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.value}와 비슷해 비용이 자산으로 쌓이지 않았으나, 사업재편 비용과 주식교환 할인 비용은 반복될 수 있다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융으로 영업현금흐름을 부풀린 흔적은 없다. 부채가 {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.value}에서 {terms.debt_now.value}로 줄어든 것은 대부분 샌디스크 주식과의 비현금 교환이며, 세금환급 시점, 미지급 성과급, 헤지 축소라는 세 가지 영업현금 시점 효과는 금액 필드가 없어 조정하지 못했다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 보고되었고 감사인 변경이나 재무책임자 교체는 없다. 다만 감가상각 태그 변경, 전환 후에도 남은 우선주 청산가치 태그, 주석과 경영진 설명의 교환비용 수치 차이 같은 표기 불일치가 있고, 실적 발표 8-K 본문이 없어 10-Q와 대조할 수 없다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 주석과 경영진 설명의 방향성 항목은 대부분 숫자와 일치하며, 재고 '감소' 서술은 잔액이 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} 늘어난 것과 어긋나지만 전년 대비 현금 사용이 줄었다는 뜻이다. 8-K 실적 발표는 번들에 없어 10-Q와 대조할 수 없다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮고 구매약정은 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value}로 줄어 재고 진부화나 과잉 약정 신호가 없다. 상위 열 개 고객이 매출의 {concentration.facts.27.value|pct}를 차지하고 최대 고객의 매출채권 비중이 {concentration.facts.35.value|pct}까지 올라간 집중도가 유일한 관찰 대상이다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
